method.owner_rule: A scalar candidate requires direct absolute memory references at offset zero with one consistent width. Address-taking immediates are recorded separately. method.anchor_rule: An anchor candidate must be a complete decoded MOV/LEA/PUSH with one exact HIGHLOW field resolving to the target and no overlap with an assigned caller.
method.search_targets: work/velocity_c/queue.json implied destinations are used only to locate candidate references; they are not identity evidence.
